talents.name: Demolition Team
talents.description: You have a 5% chance to replenish a Grenade when you or an Ally in Coherency Kills an Elite or Specialist Enemy.

talents.name: Tactical Reload
talents.description: +25% Reload Speed if your weapon contains Ammo.

talents.name: Volley Adept
talents.description: +30% Reload Speed on Elite & Specialist Enemy Kill.

talents.name: Keep Their Heads Down!
talents.description: +75% Ranged Attack Suppression.

talents.name: Exploit Weakness
talents.description: Melee Critical Hits increase Damage by 20% for 6s.

talents.name: Toughness Boost
talents.description: +25 Toughness.

talents.name: Out for Blood
talents.description: Your Kills Replenish an additional 5% Toughness.

talents.name: Skirmisher
talents.description: +6.25% to all Base Damage for 10s after Sprinting or Sliding. Stacks 4 times.

talents.name: Desperado
talents.description: +10% Melee Critical Hit Chance & +25% Melee Finesse Bonus.

talents.name: Smoke Grenade
talents.description: Throw a grenade that creates a lingering smoke cloud for 15s. The cloud blocks line of sight for most enemies and reduces the sight range of enemies inside it.

talents.name: Infiltrate
talents.description: Replenish all Toughness and enter Stealth for 8s, gaining +25% Movement Speed. Leaving Stealth Suppresses nearby Enemies. While in Stealth, and for 5s afterwards, you have +30% Damage. Attacking makes you leave Stealth. Base Cooldown: 45s.

talents.name: Leave No One Behind
talents.description: +20% Assist Speed & Revive Speed. +20% Movement Speed and Stun Immunity when moving towards a Knocked Down or Incapacitated Ally. Whenever you Revive a Knocked Down Ally, they receive +33% Damage Reduction for 5s.

talents.name: Grenadier
talents.description: You can carry 1 extra Grenade(s). 20% chance to throw an additional Grenade (this still only consumes a single Grenade).

talents.name: Rending Strikes
talents.description: Gives +10% Rending to all weapons.

talents.name: Close and Kill
talents.description: +5% Movement Speed for you and Allies in Coherency.

talents.name: Reciprocity
talents.description: +5% Critical Hit Chance for 8s on successful Dodge. Stacks 5 times.

talents.name: Agile Engagement
talents.description: Killing an enemy with a Melee Attack grants +25% Ranged Damage and killing an enemy with a Ranged Attack grants +25% Melee Damage. Lasts 6s.

talents.name: Serrated Blade
talents.description: 2 Stack(s) of Bleed to the target on Melee Hit.

talents.name: Trench Fighter Drill
talents.description: +10% Melee Attack Speed.

talents.name: Onslaught
talents.description: Continuous hits to a Single Target applies 2.5% Brittleness for 5 seconds to the target. Stacks 16 times.

talents.name: Low Profile
talents.description: -90% Threat for 10s on leaving Stealth.

talents.name: Catch a Breath
talents.description: When you haven't been the target of a Melee Attack for 5s, you start to replenish 5% Toughness per second.

talents.name: Opening Salvo
talents.description: The first 20% Ammo after a Reload has +10% Ranged Critical Hit Chance.

talents.name: Kill Zone
talents.description: +15% Base Ranged Damage when you have avoided Melee Attacks for 8s.

talents.name: Executioner's Stance
talents.description: Enter Ranged Stance for 5s. When in Ranged Stance you instantly equip your ranged weapon, deal +25% Ranged Damage, +25% Ranged Weakspot Damage, replenish 10% Toughness each second, and your Spread and Recoil are greatly reduced. Human-sized Elite Enemies and Specialist Enemies are highlighted for 5s. Killing a highlighted Enemy refreshes the duration of its bonuses for 5s. Base Cooldown: 30s.

talents.name: Shock Trooper
talents.description: Critical Hits with Las-weapons consume no Ammo.

talents.name: Enhanced Target Priority
talents.description: Executioner's Stance now outlines Elite & Specialist Enemies for Allies in Coherency for 5s.

talents.name: Get Back in the Fight!
talents.description: Stun Immunity, Slow Immunity for 6s & restore +50% Stamina when your Toughness is broken. 20s Cooldown.

talents.name: Counter-Fire
talents.description: Executioner's Stance now outlines all human-sized Ranged Enemies.

talents.name: Exhilarating Takedown
talents.description: Replenish 15% Toughness and gain +10% Toughness Damage Reduction for 8s on Ranged Weakspot Kill. Stacks 3 times. Stacks Decay one at a time.

talents.name: Hunter's Resolve
talents.description: Infiltrate provides +50% Toughness Damage Reduction for 10s on leaving Stealth.

talents.name: Competitive Urge
talents.description: 2.5% chance of +20% Base Damage, +20% Melee Impact & +20% Suppression for 8s whenever an Ally kills an Enemy.
